about_the_game:
Death Kitchen is a fast-paced co-op cooking horror game for 1-5 players where angry alien customers will hunt you down if you fail to serve them correctly. Mistakes are fatal. Meet the quota and move on to the next day or the restaurant will explode.

PLAY WITH FRIENDS 

Play solo or with up to 4 friends as you scramble to cook, serve, and survive. Communication is critical and one wrong order can cost you your life.

PROXIMITY CHAT

Built-in proximity voice and text chat amplifies communication between teammates. Hear your teammate screaming? Oh no!

ROLES

You can choose to be a chef or a waiter at the beginning of each day. Chefs cook faster and waiters can interact with customers faster. Each role has tradeoffs so pick carefully! The synergy between chefs and waiters is essential.

COOKING FEATURES

Some stations in your kitchen have mini-games! Others are realistic cooking. Be sure not to overcook, it will catch fire! Use the shop in-game for upgrades!

COLLECTING INGREDIENTS

Go outside the restaurant to collect ingredients. You can grab ingredients at any time but be strategic about it or you may get overloaded with customers.

AGGRESSIVE ALIEN CUSTOMERS

Every customer is unique and unpredictable. Make sure you serve them before they quickly run out of patience and do not mess up their order. Otherwise, they will start attacking you until you’re dead! Defend yourself with weapons from the shop.

GHOST AND QUOTA MANAGEMENT

Did you die from the customers? It’s not over! You’ll turn into a ghost and you can help around in the restaurant but your friends can’t see or hear you! Your friends can revive you on the next day if the quota is met. Be careful, if all of you die, then it’s game over. 

MANY NEW WILD PLANETS AWAIT

Every planet has different unique traits and ingredients. Some of them will blow your mind! Survive on an unstable planet or climb a mountain to gather ingredients!

  • Online co-op for 1–5 players

  • Proximity voice and text chat for immersive teamwork and panic

  • Lobby chat and direct messaging to coordinate before starting a game

  • Role-based gameplay with meaningful tradeoffs

  • Weapon and upgrade shop system

  • Multiple customization options

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Quad Core Intel i5 or Ryzen 5 equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GForce GTX 1060
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Quad Core Intel i7 or Ryzen 7 equivalent
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GForce RTX 2060

short_description: Death Kitchen is a fast-paced online co-op horror cooking game. Decide between a chef and a waiter, then coordinate with your friends to serve alien customers who can kill you if you make a mistake. Embrace the chaos and deliver quality with your new intergalactic restaurant chain.

English*, Korean, Simplified Chinese
